# form.addRotaryEncoder

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 26.1.0</span></div>

Add a rotary encoder widget.

```lua
form.addRotaryEncoder(line, rect)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `line` | FormLine | yes | the line where the widget should be added |
| `rect` | Rect | yes | the coordinates |

## Returns

Nothing.

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
form.addRotaryEncoder(nil, {x=0, y=0})
```
